en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a bustling European town square with market stalls and horse‑drawn wagons. On the left stands a neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance town hall with a small belfry and clock. In the center background is a tall corner building marked "HOTEL BAUM." To the right runs a row of ornate late‑19th‑century facades, including a building clearly signed "APOTHEKE" (pharmacy). In the foreground is a large sculptural fountain with figures on rocks and a basin, placed on a stepped plinth. People in early‑20th‑century dress walk and trade in the square, and hills can be seen in the distance.
